lines: Trench Dogs have arrived on the front.
Each one has its own name, and it never leaves its soldier.
They sit beside real players, on the real front.
Now and then, a dog gets its own story in your soldier's diary.
And if your soldier falls, the dog stays with the family. It waits for the next one.
Trench Dogs come with Field Post and Officers' Mess on Patreon.
The game stays free. Thank you for keeping the front fed.
